## Use SUSE Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set SUSE Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'SUSE Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

Copy

## Where to get SUSE Mono

SUSE Mono is available from Google Fonts.

[Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/SUSE+Mono)

## About the SUSE Mono coding font

SUSE's open-source brand monospace. SUSE Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

SUSE Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## SUSE Mono FAQ

### Is SUSE Mono free?

Yes. SUSE Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does SUSE Mono support ligatures?

No. SUSE Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get SUSE Mono?

SUSE Mono is available from Google Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
